title: Audio Record
description: Physical representation of a radio broadcast audio record as recognized by an ASR engine.

id.description: Canonical ID of the radio broadcast audio record, for example `[INA alias]-1940-07-22-a-r0001`.

iiif_base_uri.description: Base URI of the IIIF manifest.

stt.description: Start time of the audio recording, relative to the broadcasting day, in HH:MM:SS format. Defaults to 00:00:00 when unavailable.

dur.description: Total duration of the audio broadcast in HH:MM:SS format.

st.description: Type of source represented by this audio recording. Must be a value from the `impresso_essentials.utils.SourceType` enum.

sm.description: Original production medium of the source represented by this audio recording.

cdt.description: Creation timestamp of the JSON file.

ts.description: Creation timestamp of the JSON file, in `%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ` format.

items.description: A section of the audio broadcast, equivalent to a page region in print media.

tc.description: Time coordinates of the section, relative to the audio recording.

u.description: List of speech utterances, each grouping consecutive same-speaker segments derived from ASR diarization of the original file.

tc.description: Time coordinates of the utterance, relative to the audio recording.

speaker.description: Speaker id or name for this utterance.

tc.description: Time coordinates of the speech segment, relative to the audio recording.

t.description: Speech tokens (as detected by the ASR engine).

tc.description: Time coordinates of the speech token, relative to the audio recording.

pOf.description: Canonical ID of the content item to which the section belongs.

time_coordinates.description: Audio segment coordinates as `[start_time, duration]`, with both values expressed in seconds.
